method: Individually generated chibi fan illustrations using the built-in image_gen tool. Existing game portraits were supplied as character-identity references; the approved Amiya illustration was the style reference for the other nine portraits. WebP exports resize the complete artwork without cropping its silhouette.
selection: A curated set of familiar characters, not an official popularity ranking.
rights: Unofficial fan illustrations. The underlying characters and associated rights belong to their respective owners. Original drawing does not imply a license from the game rights holder or a guarantee of no infringement.
generator: Built-in image_gen; recorded prompts in material/guestbook-art-v2/prompts.json
legacy: The initial SVG drafts remain archived but are no longer selected by the guestbook.
